Byte lengths of an HQC parameter set

Source: R/hqc.R
hqcsz.Rd

Reports the byte lengths that the HQC specification fixes for a security level: the encapsulation (public) key, the decapsulation (secret) key, the ciphertext, the key-generation seed, the encapsulation randomness and the shared secret. Use it to validate stored keys and ciphertexts, or to size storage, without hard-coding numbers.

Usage

hqcsz(lvl, ver = c("v5", "round4"))

Arguments

lvl

Security level: 1, 3 or 5 (or 128, 192, 256 for the same three). There is no default.

ver

"v5" (the default) or "round4", as in hqckg().

Value

A named integer vector: encapsulation_key, decapsulation_key, ciphertext, seed (key generation), message and salt (encapsulation randomness) and shared_secret, all in bytes.

Details

The values come from the compiled implementation, so they are the sizes it actually uses. For version = "v5" (specification of 2025-08-22):

HQC-1HQC-3HQC-5
encapsulation key224145147237
decapsulation key232146027333
ciphertext4433897814421
seed323232
message162432
salt161616
shared secret323232

For version = "round4" the codes are the same but the key encoding differs: the seed is 96, 104 or 112 bytes and the shared secret 64 bytes. A level other than 1, 3, 5 (or 128, 192, 256) is an error.

See also

hqckg(), kemsz() for ML-KEM.

Examples

hqcsz(1)
#> encapsulation_key decapsulation_key        ciphertext              seed 
#>              2241              2321              4433                32 
#>           message              salt     shared_secret 
#>                16                16                32 

# code-based keys and ciphertexts are larger than ML-KEM's at the same
# category; the shared secret is 32 bytes at every level (64 in round 4)
rbind(HQC = hqcsz(3)[c("encapsulation_key", "ciphertext")],
      MLKEM = kemsz(768)[c("encapsulation_key", "ciphertext")])
#>       encapsulation_key ciphertext
#> HQC                4514       8978
#> MLKEM              1184       1088
rbind(v5 = hqcsz(1), round4 = hqcsz(1, "round4"))
#>        encapsulation_key decapsulation_key ciphertext seed message salt
#> v5                  2241              2321       4433   32      16   16
#> round4              2249              2305       4433   96      16   16
#>        shared_secret
#> v5                32
#> round4            64

# check a stored public key's length
key <- hqckg(1)
nchar(key$public) / 2 == hqcsz(1)[["encapsulation_key"]]
#> [1] TRUE

# an unknown level is refused rather than mapped to a default
try(hqcsz(2))
#> Error : `level` must be one of 1, 3 or 5 (HQC-1, HQC-3, HQC-5)
